# Brandex — Personal Branding Studio, Chennai

> Brandex is a dedicated personal branding studio in Chennai (Valasaravakkam) for doctors, entrepreneurs, chartered accountants, educators and other professionals. End-to-end service: script writing, studio-grade B-roll shooting with cinema cameras and advanced lighting, cinematic editing, and publishing to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook. Service is offered in Chennai only.

- Website: https://www.brandexpro.in/

- Studio: #5 Velan Nagar Second Street, Valasarvakkam, Chennai 600087
- Pricing: quoted after a short call (no public price list)

## Blog
- [Personal Branding for Doctors in Chennai: What Works Under the New NMC Rules](https://www.brandexpro.in/blog/personal-branding-for-doctors-chennai): Under the NMC guidelines of 6 Oct 2026, doctors may publish educational/awareness videos with name, qualification and register number disclosed, but no testimonials, before-and-after clips, guaranteed outcomes or paid influencer promotion. Batch shoot: one 3-hour morning per month produces 10–15 compliant videos.
